visualizations.label: Summary card

visualizations.description: Trends-tab style card comparing current and prior windows.

params.label: Metric

visualizations.label: Vitals rings
visualizations.description: Radial daily rings for steps, active calories, and heart context.

visualizations.label: Mood trend
visualizations.description: State of Mind mood valence over time with optional sleep and exercise context.

params.desc: Draw faint sleep duration and exercise/workout bars behind the mood trend.

visualizations.label: Mood calendar heatmap
visualizations.description: Calendar grid colored by average State of Mind valence.

visualizations.label: Mood × sleep scatter
visualizations.description: Scatterplot comparing daily mood valence with sleep duration and exercise context.

visualizations.label: Mood day timeline
visualizations.description: Time-of-day lanes for mood entries, with sleep spans behind each day.

params.label: Max days
params.desc: Maximum number of recent days to draw as timeline rows.

visualizations.label: Mood association breakdown
visualizations.description: Average mood valence grouped by State of Mind association such as Work, Fitness, or Family.

params.label: Limit
params.desc: Maximum number of associations to show.

visualizations.label: Mood label cloud
visualizations.description: Emotion labels sized by frequency and colored by average valence.

params.label: Limit
params.desc: Maximum number of labels to include.

visualizations.label: Mood volatility
visualizations.description: Daily mood average with bars showing the spread between lowest and highest entries.

visualizations.description: Compares Daily Mood entries with Momentary Emotion entries over time.

visualizations.description: Radial 24-hour clock showing when mood entries happen and how pleasant they are.

visualizations.label: Mood recovery tile
visualizations.description: Recovery and mindset card combining latest mood, sleep, HRV, and exercise context.

visualizations.label: Mood association matrix
visualizations.description: Matrix of emotion labels by associations, colored by valence or count.

params.desc: Choose whether cells show average valence or entry count.

params.desc: Maximum number of recent medication dose events to list.

params.desc: Group adherence trend bars by day, week, month, or choose automatically from the date range.

visualizations.label: Recent dose events
visualizations.description: Standalone table of the most recent medication dose events in the selected range.

params.label: Recent events
params.desc: Maximum number of recent medication dose events to list.

visualizations.label: Walking symmetry

params.desc: Optional workout day to select, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.desc: Optional BPM used to draw heart-rate zone bands.

visualizations.label: Workout zones

params.label: Workout date
params.desc: Optional workout day to select, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.desc: Zero-based workout number on that day. 0 means first workout.

params.desc: Optional BPM used to derive zones from samples when frontmatter zones are absent.

visualizations.label: Workout trends
visualizations.description: Trends for duration, distance, calories, average HR, and power.

params.desc: Choose all workout trend panels or focus one metric.

visualizations.label: Workout intervals
visualizations.description: HTML table for detailed workout laps and splits.

params.label: Workout date
params.desc: Optional workout day to select, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.desc: Zero-based workout number on that day. 0 means first workout.

visualizations.description: GPS route map for one selected outdoor workout.

params.label: Workout date
params.desc: Optional workout day to select, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.label: Workout index
params.desc: Zero-based workout number on that day. 0 means first workout.

params.desc: Color route segments by speed or nearest heart-rate sample.

params.desc: Optional positive number of days for a rolling average.

params.desc: Optional user-provided reference line. No medical threshold is assumed.
